title: asset_provenance
description: Where every transferred asset came from, what it weighs, and whether shipping it is the owner's decision. A donor snapshot carries the donor's own brand material: logos, showreels, portfolio imagery. Copying geometry is the job; republishing someone else's brand or a multi-megabyte video is a decision, not a side effect.

size_threshold_bytes.description: Assets at or above this size need an explicit owner decision. Default 1048576 (1 MB).

path.description: Path as shipped in the candidate, e.g. public/hero-showreel.mp4

origin.description: Where the bytes came from: an extracted h2d asset id, a donor CDN URL, or the candidate's own material.

third_party_brand.description: True when the asset depicts or belongs to the donor's brand rather than the candidate's.

owner_decision.description: Required when third_party_brand is true or bytes exceed the threshold.
